t: This is the former Geological Museum, on Exhibition Road in South Kensington, next door to the Natural History Museum. It's now part of that museum. The collection began in 1835, which made it one of the oldest public single-science collections in the world, and it moved here from Jermyn Street in 1935. The building was designed by Sir Richard Allison and John Hatton Markham of the Office of Works. The museum was founded by Henry De la Beche, the first director of the Geological Survey of Great Britain, who helped pioneer early geological survey methods.
